# Pre-purge root set (cr-51 pre-purge gate).
# One full lowercase commit SHA per line (optional trailing # comment). The gate fails any branch whose
# HEAD descends from a listed commit, so a pre-purge branch cannot reintroduce the
# credential history on merge.
#
# EMPTY until the separately approved operator history purge records the old tips.
# Nonempty valid roots arm blocking secrets-history, path-history and pre-purge
# checks. Empty roots preserve informational CI behavior; release-containment
# refuses certification while unarmed. Never add guessed or abbreviated roots.
# Inspect full history in a fresh post-purge clone. This list does not prove
# operator cache removal or revoke copied credentials. Rotation and KBD signer
# replacement are operator-deferred and are not prerequisites for these checks.
